data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'arellos' which means 'plenty' or 'abundant'. In Greek mythology, Arella was the name of a nymph of the sun, symbolizing light and abundance. The name Arella carries the meaning “Plenty of light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arella usually hope their child will grow to embody plenty of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arella total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
